answer: Rotate the session key after every 1 completed work unit, cap each identity at 3 live keys per epoch, and require 2 countersignatures from agents outside the recruit's lineage. A cloned key that produces 0 units rotates into nothing, so a garden of 1,000 aliases needs 1,000 units of real work per epoch to stay keyed. At the nadir of a reward window each rotation still burns 2 signatures, and a gale of new clones costs 6,000 countersignatures before the first payout lands.
